items.tr: herkesin gördüğü ama konuşmadığı büyük sorun
items.example: Nobody mentioned the elephant in the room: the budget cuts.
items.exampleTr: Kimse ortadaki büyük meseleden, bütçe kesintilerinden bahsetmedi.
items.simple: A big problem that everyone sees but nobody wants to talk about.

items.example: Stop beating around the bush and tell me.
items.exampleTr: Lafı dolandırmayı bırak ve söyle.
items.simple: You do not say the thing straight. You talk about other things first.

items.example: These complaints are just the tip of the iceberg.
items.exampleTr: Bu şikayetler sadece buzdağının görünen kısmı.
items.simple: The small part you can see, while a much bigger part is hidden.

items.en: hit the nail on the head
items.tr: tam isabet etmek, tam yerinde söylemek
items.example: You hit the nail on the head with that comment.
items.exampleTr: O yorumunla tam isabet ettirdin.
items.simple: What you say is exactly right.

items.example: Fifty pounds is a drop in the ocean for a project this big.
items.exampleTr: Bu kadar büyük bir proje için elli pound devede kulak.
items.simple: A tiny part of what you really need.

items.example: They made him the scapegoat for the whole mess.
items.exampleTr: Bütün curcunanın günah keçisi onu yaptılar.
items.simple: A person who gets the blame for something others did.

items.example: The party turned into a complete fiasco.
items.exampleTr: Parti tam bir fiyaskoya dönüştü.
items.simple: A plan that goes very, very wrong in a big way.

items.example: They found a loophole in the contract.
items.exampleTr: Sözleşmede bir boşluk buldular.
items.simple: A small gap in a rule that lets you avoid it.

items.example: I know it's a cliché, but time really does fly.
items.exampleTr: Klişe olduğunu biliyorum ama zaman gerçekten uçuyor.
items.simple: Something said so many times that it feels boring and old.

items.example: We used a box as a makeshift table.
items.exampleTr: Geçici masa olarak bir kutu kullandık.
items.simple: Made quickly from things you have, not as good as the real thing.

items.example: I think the free gift is just a gimmick.
items.exampleTr: Bence bedava hediye sadece bir numara.
items.simple: A trick that gets attention, but is not really useful.

items.example: One of his quirks is that he never uses a phone.
items.exampleTr: Tuhaf huylarından biri hiç telefon kullanmaması.
items.simple: A funny little habit that only that person has.

items.example: Let's see how things pan out before we decide.
items.exampleTr: Karar vermeden önce işlerin nasıl gelişeceğine bakalım.
items.simple: You wait to see how it ends in the end.

items.example: Don't worry. This will all blow over soon.
items.exampleTr: Merak etme. Bunların hepsi yakında unutulur.
items.simple: A problem goes away by itself after a little time.

items.example: They cut corners to save money, and it showed.
items.exampleTr: Para kazanmak için kolaya kaçtılar ve belli oldu.
items.simple: You do a job the quick, easy way, not the right way.

items.example: I don't want to rock the boat right before the deadline.
items.exampleTr: Son tarihten hemen önce ortalığı karıştırmak istemem.
items.simple: You change things and make everyone upset when all was calm.

items.example: Asking about his salary would open a can of worms.
items.exampleTr: Maaşını sormak pandoranın kutusunu açar.
items.simple: You begin something that causes many new problems.

items.example: Come on, spill the beans! Who's the new boss?
items.exampleTr: Hadi, baklayı çıkar! Yeni patron kim?
items.simple: You tell a secret that you should not tell.

items.en: Easier said than done. Quitting is easier said than done.
items.example: Saving money is easier said than done.
items.exampleTr: Para biriktirmek söylemesi kolay.
items.simple: It sounds simple, but doing it is hard.

items.en: Let's not jump to conclusions. Let's not jump to conclusions yet.
items.example: Let's not jump to conclusions before we hear his side.
items.exampleTr: Onun tarafını dinlemeden sonuca atlamayalım.
items.simple: You wait to know all the facts before you decide.

items.en: The ball is in your court. The ball is in your court now.
items.example: I've sent my offer, so the ball is in your court.
items.exampleTr: Teklifimi gönderdim, top sende.
items.simple: It is your turn to do something now.

items.tr: boş yere peşinden koşmak, nafile uğraş
items.example: The address was wrong, so it was a wild goose chase.
items.exampleTr: Adres yanlıştı, boşuna koşturduk.
items.simple: You look hard for something, but it is not there.

items.tr: kötü sonun işareti, gelen felaketin belirtisi
items.example: The writing was on the wall long before the shop closed.
items.exampleTr: Dükkan kapanmadan çok önce kötü sonun işaretleri vardı.
items.simple: Signs that tell you something bad will happen soon.

items.example: Don't worry, it's just a storm in a teacup.
items.exampleTr: Endişelenme, sadece fincandaki fırtına.
items.simple: A lot of fuss about something very small.
